components.reason: skiko is Apache-2.0 with no NOTICE file; its DLL bundles Skia (BSD-3-Clause) and, per the generator's read-only byte probe, libjpeg-turbo, libpng, zlib, HarfBuzz, ICU, expat and Wuffs. FreeType and libwebp were not detected. ICU is classified Unicode-3.0 (owner decision 2026-11-04); its GPL-with-exception text covers build-time autoconf files not compiled into the DLL. Windows build configuration (skia-pack: skia_use_direct3d=true, is_official_build; Skia gn defaults: skia_use_libwebp_decode/encode=true, skia_use_piex=!is_win so no dng_sdk/piex, skia_use_freetype false on Windows) adds D3D12MemoryAllocator, SPIRV-Cross and libwebp; the byte probe also finds SPIRV-Cross and WebP chunk tags.
